Bug_Explanation: The bug is embedded in the showBug() method where a FileInputStream object is not closed in the finally block. This can lead to resource leaks.
Trigger_Explanation: The test case creates an instance of the buggy class and calls the showBug() method. Since the resource (FileInputStream) is not closed in the finally block of the showBug() method, this test will fail and trigger the CloseResource bug.
Bug_Trigger_Explanation: The test run results show that the test passed successfully without any failures. This indicates that the resource was not leaked, as the test would have failed if the resource was not closed in the finally block, which would have triggered the bug.
